H4210: properly, instrumental music; by implication, a poem set to notes
H1732: David, the youngest son of Jesse
H3051: to give (whether literal or figurative); generally, to put; imperatively (reflexive) come
H3068: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
H1121: a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense (of literal and figurative relationship, including grandson, subject, nation, quality or condition, etc., (like father or brother), etc.)
H410: strength; as adjective, mighty; especially the Almighty (but used also of any deity)
H3519: properly, weight, but only figuratively in a good sense, splendor or copiousness
H5797: strength in various applications (force, security, majesty, praise)
H8034: an appellation, as amark or memorial of individuality; by implication honor, authority, character
H7812: to depress, i.e. prostrate (especially reflexive, in homage to royalty or God)
H6944: a sacred place or thing; rarely abstract, sanctity
H5921: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
H4325: water; figuratively, juice; by euphemism, urine, semen
H7481: to tumble, i.e. be violently agitated; specifically, to crash (of thunder); figuratively, to irritate (with anger)
H7227: abundant (in quantity, size, age, number, rank, quality)
H3581: vigor, literally (force, in a good or a bad sense) or figuratively (capacity, means, produce); also (from its hardiness) a large lizard
H730: a cedar tree (from the tenacity of its roots)
H853: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
H3844: Lebanon, a mountain range in Palestine
H7540: properly, to stamp, i.e. to spring about (wildly or for joy)
H3644: a form of the prefix 'k-', but used separately as, thus, so
H5695: a (male) calf (as frisking round), especially one nearly grown (i.e. a steer)
H8303: Shirjon or Sirjon, a peak of the Lebanon
H2672: to cut or carve (wood, stone or other material); by implication, to hew, split, square, quarry, engrave
H3852: {a flash; figuratively, a sharply polished blade or point of aweapon}
H2342: properly, to twist or whirl (in a circular or spiral manner), i.e. (specifically) to dance, to writhe in pain (especially of parturition) or fear; figuratively, to wait, to pervert
H4057: a pasture (i.e. open field, whither cattle are driven); by implication, a desert; also speech (including its organs)
H6946: Kadesh, a place in the Desert
H2834: to strip off, i.e. generally to make naked (for exertion or in disgrace), to drain away or bail up (a liquid)
H3293: a copse of bushes; hence, a forest; hence, honey in the comb (as hived in trees)
H1964: a large public building, such as a palace or temple
H3605: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
H3427: properly, to sit down (specifically as judge. in ambush, in quiet); by implication, to dwell, to remain; causatively, to settle, to marry
H5769: properly, concealed, i.e. the vanishing point; generally, time out of mind (past or future), i.e. (practically) eternity; frequentatively, adverbial (especially with prepositional prefix) always
H5971: a people (as a congregated unit); specifically, a tribe (as those of Israel); hence (collectively) troops or attendants; figuratively, a flock
H5414: to give, used with greatest latitude of application (put, make, etc.)
H1288: to kneel; by implication to bless God (as an act of adoration), and (vice-versa) man (as a benefit); also (by euphemism) to curse (God or the king, as treason)
H7965: safe, i.e. (figuratively) well, happy, friendly; also (abstractly) welfare, i.e. health, prosperity, peace
